answer: In this PoA design, reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so each identity must deliver sustained, reciprocated honest service to retain influence. EigenTrust factorization assigns freshly spawned Sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality: a dune, thread, or shale persona lacks trusted incoming mass and cannot bootstrap voting weight or pass consensus. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity further prevents collusive identities from amplifying one another.
